$comment: Traceability: computer_leases table and the journal's Takeover/HumanReady/Resume/Observed sequence, ported per control-core-unification.md §4 ('controller lease, generation fencing, explicit re-acquire'). The worker never initiates lease commands. pause: stop dispatching new actions (the journal's pausing); resume: re-observe and continue. When observation_required is true, the worker must append run.resumed with a fresh workspace observation_digest before the service treats the turn as live again.

lease_generation.description: The new controller-lease generation. The worker records it; any in-flight worker message under the old generation is rejected service-side from here on.

observation_required.description: On resume: the worker must re-observe the workspace and report run.resumed with a fresh digest (durable.rs Observed).

title: service.lease.command
